breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions, specifying both Dirichlet conditions on all four edges and periodic conditions. The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect periodic condition. The generated specification correctly omits any mention of periodic boundaries and only lists the four Dirichlet conditions, thus successfully resolving the inconsistency.
